summary: AT3 (Admin Team Phase 3 — team-member sidebar access + request-access flow) end-to-end verified. 3/3 unit regression + 7/7 live backend E2E tests passed; Playwright UI check confirmed rail-icon-admin renders for team member, /admin no longer bounces, admin sidebar is correctly filtered to only the 2 nav items matching the member's screen overrides ({users.all:view, ora.bugs:manage} -> 'Users (Legacy)' + 'Self-Repair Log'), the 'Request more access' footer button opens the RequestAccessModal (screen select + note + Send request), and /admin/team is correctly absent from the member's nav.

issues: Pre-existing (OUT OF SCOPE per handoff): '2FA session required' banner shows on data widgets inside Users (Legacy) because the team-member fixture has not completed MFA enrollment. Not an AT3 bug.

critical_code_review_comments: RequestAccessModal is rendered with inline-style overlay (zIndex 1000) and NO portal — works today, but if any admin page introduces a modal with higher z-index or stacking context issues this could regress. Minor hardening suggestion only.

The member's /admin landed on /admin/users directly (first accessible tab) rather than briefly flashing /admin and then redirecting — redirect effect uses `replace` which correctly avoids back-button loops. Verified.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_at3_live_e2e.py (new live E2E tests, 7 tests, all passing)

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested member path (6/6 criteria confirmed)

test_credentials: Owner: test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026! (unchanged). Team member fixture: sidebar-at3-test@example.com / SidebarAt3Test2026! (unchanged, overrides {users.all:view, ora.bugs:manage}).
seed_data_creation: test_at3_live_e2e.py creates/resolves transient access-requests and auto-cleans. test_resolve_does_not_grant_screen leaves one approved-but-not-granted request on `ora.autonomy.allowlist` which is harmless (approval does not grant; it's a notification artifact). Also created one throwaway signup account per run in test_unrelated_user_cannot_hit_my_access.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner-side UI verification (/admin/team Access requests section, approve/deny buttons, TeamInviteAccept 2-button layout) was NOT UI-tested here because the Owner account requires live MFA (TOTP) which cannot be automated with Playwright. However, the owner-only endpoints GET /admin/team/access-requests and POST /admin/team/access-requests/{id}/resolve were verified end-to-end in test_at3_live_e2e.py (owner lists the pending request a member just created, resolves it with action=deny, 200 OK; 403 for non-owner on both endpoints). The AdminTeamPage.jsx UI consumes those exact endpoints, so correctness is strongly implied but not visually confirmed. If future work removes MFA on the owner or adds a bypass, re-run the UI checks for the Access requests section + Approve/Deny buttons + notification bell toasts.
